Because npm\nis stuck at `0.63.0`, the self-update mechanism itself is structurally\nincapable of noticing four months of missed releases; it will happily report\n\"you're up to date\" against a version that is itself stale.\n\nRoot cause: GitHub Actions is disabled at the repo level for `jedarden/CLASP`\n(`gh api repos/jedarden/CLASP/actions/permissions` → `enabled: false`),\nconsistent with this workspace's fleet-wide \"GitHub Actions are disabled —\nuse Argo instead\" policy. `.github/workflows/release.yml` (the old\nversion-bump + npm-publish + gh-release automation) has been dead since\nActions were turned off, and nothing replaced its full scope — the Argo\n`clasp-build` template that was eventually created only builds/pushes a\nDocker image (to a registry nobody uses), never publishes npm or uploads\nrelease binaries, and even that has never been triggered.\n\n### Decision\n\nAdopt a single Argo Workflow on `iad-ci` as the canonical, sole release\npipeline for CLASP, replacing the dead `release.yml` and superseding the\nexisting `clasp-build` template's narrow scope. CLASP is a lightweight Go proxy that sits between Claude Code and your chosen provider, translating the Anthropic Messages API to OpenAI Chat Completions in real time.\n4\t\n5\t```\n6\tClaude Code  →  CLASP (:8080)  →  OpenAI / Azure / OpenRouter / Ollama / custom\n7\t```\n8\t\n9\tNo patches to Claude Code. Override all other settings\n116\t2. **Environment variables** - Override config file settings\n117\t3. **Configuration file** - YAML-based configuration\n118\t4. **Default values** - Built-in defaults\n119\t\n120\t### Configuration File\n121\t\n122\tCLASP can load configuration from a YAML file, which is cleaner for complex setups and version control friendly.\n123\t\n124\t**Configuration file locations** (searched in order):\n125\t1. `./clasp.yaml` or `./clasp.yml` - Current directory\n126\t2. `~/.clasp/config.yaml` - User config directory\n127\t3. `~/.config/clasp/config.yaml` - XDG config directory\n128\t4. `/etc/clasp/config.yaml` - System-wide config\n129\t5. Custom path via `CLASP_CONFIG_FILE` environment variable\n130\t\n131\t**Example configuration file** (`clasp.yaml`):\n132\t\n133\t```yaml\n134\t# Provider selection\n135\tprovider: Caching\n363\t\n364\tCLASP can cache responses to reduce API costs and improve latency for repeated requests:\n365\t\n366\t```bash\n367\t# Enable caching with defaults (1000 entries, 1 hour TTL)\n368\tclasp -cache\n369\t\n370\t# Custom cache settings\n371\tclasp -cache -cache-max-size 500 -cache-ttl 1800\n372\t\n373\t# Via environment\n374\tCLASP_CACHE=true CLASP_CACHE_MAX_SIZE=500 clasp\n375\t```\n376\t\n377\t**Caching behavior:**\n378\t- Only non-streaming requests are cached\n379\t- Requests with `temperature > 0` are not cached (non-deterministic)\n380\t- Cache uses LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction when full\n381\t- Cache entries expire after TTL (time-to-live)\n382\t- Response headers include `X-CLASP-Cache: HIT` or `X-CLASP-Cache: MISS`\n383\t\n384\t## Metrics\n385\t\n386\tAccess `/metrics` for request statistics:\n387\t\n388\t```json\n389\t{\n390\t  \"requests\": {\n391\t    \"total\": 100,\n392\t    \"successful\": 98,\n393\t    \"errors\": |\n597\t| `CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RECOVERY` | Successes to close circuit | `2` |\n598\t| `CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TIMEOUT` | Timeout in seconds before retry | `30` |\n599\t\n600\t### Circuit Breaker States\n601\t\n602\t- **Closed**: Normal operation, requests pass through\n603\t- **Open**: Circuit tripped, requests fail fast with 503\n604\t- **Half-Open**: Testing if service recovered, limited requests allowed\n605\t\n606\t### Maximum Resilience Configuration\n607\t\n608\tFor production deployments requiring maximum resilience:\n609\t\n610\t```bash\n611\t# Enable queue + circuit breaker + CLASP is a lightweight Go proxy that sits between Claude Code and your chosen provider, translating the Anthropic Messages API to OpenAI Chat Completions in real time.\n\n```\nClaude Code  →  CLASP (:8080)  →  OpenAI / Azure / OpenRouter / Ollama / custom\n```\n\nNo patches to Claude Code. No forks. Just point `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` at the proxy and go.\n\n## Features\n\n- **Bundled Claude Code**: Automatically includes Claude Code as a dependency - single `npx clasp-ai` installs everything\n- **Multi-Provider Support**: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter (200+ models), and custom endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio)\n- **Full Protocol Translation**: Anthropic Messages API ↔ OpenAI Chat Completions API\n- **SSE Streaming**: Real-time token streaming with state machine processing\n- **Tool Calls**: Complete translation of tool_use/tool_result between formats\n- **Connection Pooling**: Optimized HTTP transport with persistent connections\n- **Retry Logic**: Exponential backoff for transient failures\n- **Metrics Endpoint**: Request statistics and performance monitoring\n- **API Key Authentication**: Secure the proxy with optional API key validation\n\n## Installation\n\n### Via npm (recommended)\n\n```bash\n# Install globally\nnpm install -g clasp-ai\n\n# Or run directly with npx\nnpx clasp-ai\n```\n\n### Via Go\n\n```bash\ngo install github.com/jedarden/clasp/cmd/clasp@latest\n```\n\n### From Source\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/jedarden/CLASP.git\ncd CLASP\nmake build\n```\n\n### Via Docker\n\n```bash\n# Run with Docker (from GitHub Container Registry)\ndocker run -d -p 8080:8080 \\\n  -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... \\\n  ghcr.io/jedarden/clasp:latest\n\n# With specific version\ndocker run -d -p 8080:8080 \\\n  -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... \\\n  ghcr.io/jedarden/clasp:0.24.8\n\n# Or with docker-compose\ndocker-compose up -d\n```\n\n**Available Docker tags:**\n- `latest` - Latest stable release\n- `0.24` - Latest 0.24.x release\n- `0.24.8` - Specific version\n\n## Quick Start\n\n### Using with OpenAI\n\n```bash\n# Set your API key\nexport OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...\n\n# Start the proxy\nclasp -model gpt-4o\n\n# In another terminal, use Claude Code\nANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 claude\n```\n\n### Using with Azure OpenAI\n\n```bash\nexport AZURE_API_KEY=your-key\nexport AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT=https://your-resource.openai.azure.com\nexport AZURE_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=gpt-4\n\nclasp -provider azure\n```\n\n### Using with OpenRouter\n\n```bash\nexport OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-...\n\nclasp -provider openrouter -model anthropic/claude-3-sonnet\n```\n\n### Using with Local Models (Ollama)\n\n```bash\nexport CUSTOM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1\n\nclasp -provider custom -model llama3.1\n```\n\n## Configuration\n\nCLASP supports three configuration methods, with the following precedence (highest to lowest):\n1. **Command-line flags** - Override all other settings\n2. **Environment variables** - Override config file settings\n3. **Configuration file** - YAML-based configuration\n4. **Default values** - Built-in defaults\n\n### Configuration File\n\nCLASP can load configuration from a YAML file, which is cleaner for complex setups and version control friendly.\n\n**Configuration file locations** (searched in order):\n1. `./clasp.yaml` or `./clasp.yml` - Current directory\n2. `~/.clasp/config.yaml` - User config directory\n3. `~/.config/clasp/config.yaml` - XDG config directory\n4. `/etc/clasp/config.yaml` - System-wide config\n5. Custom path via `CLASP_CONFIG_FILE` environment variable\n\n**Example configuration file** (`clasp.yaml`):\n\n```yaml\n# Provider selection\nprovider: openai\n\n# API Keys (supports ${VAR} syntax for environment variables)\napi_keys:\n  openai: ${OPENAI_API_KEY}\n  # azure: ${AZURE_API_KEY}\n  # openrouter: ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}\n\n# Custom endpoints (optional)\nendpoints:\n  openai: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  ollama: http://localhost:11434\n\n# Model configuration\nmodels:\n  default: gpt-4o\n  opus: gpt-4o           # Maps claude-opus-* to gpt-4o\n  sonnet: gpt-4o-mini    # Maps claude-sonnet-* to gpt-4o-mini\n  haiku: gpt-4o-mini     # Maps claude-haiku-* to gpt-4o-mini\n\n# Server settings\nserver:\n  port: 8080\n  log_level: info\n\n# Feature toggles\ncache:\n  enabled: true\n  max_size: 1000\n  ttl: 3600\n\nrate_limit:\n  enabled: false\n  requests: 60\n  window: 60\n\n# Multi-provider routing\nmulti_provider:\n  enabled: false\n  opus:\n    provider: openai\n    model: gpt-4o\n  sonnet:\n    provider: anthropic\n    model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514\n```\n\n**Environment variable expansion:**\n\nThe config file supports `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}` syntax:\n\n```yaml\napi_keys:\n  openai: ${OPENAI_API_KEY}\n  openrouter: ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY:-sk-or-default-key}\n```\n\n**Complete example:** See [clasp.example.yaml](clasp.example.yaml) for all available options.\n\n### Command Line Options\n\n```\nclasp [options]\n\nOptions:\n  -port <port>           Port to listen on (default: 8080)\n  -provider <name>       LLM provider: openai, azure, openrouter, custom\n  -model <model>         Default model to use for all requests\n  -debug                 Enable debug logging (full request/response)\n  -rate-limit            Enable rate limiting\n  -cache                 Enable response caching\n  -cache-max-size <n>    Maximum cache entries (default: 1000)\n  -cache-ttl <n>         Cache TTL in seconds (default: 3600)\n  -multi-provider        Enable multi-provider tier routing\n  -fallback              Enable fallback routing for auto-failover\n  -auth                  Enable API key authentication\n  -auth-api-key <key>    API key for authentication (required with -auth)\n  -version               Show version information\n  -help                  Show help message\n```\n\n### Environment Variables\n\n| Variable | Description | Default |\n|----------|-------------|---------|\n| `PROVIDER` | LLM provider type | `openai` |\n| `CLASP_PORT` | Proxy server | OpenRouter API key | - |\n| `CUSTOM_BASE_URL` | Custom endpoint base URL | - |\n| `CUSTOM_API_KEY` | Custom endpoint API key | - |\n| `CLASP_DEBUG` | Enable all debug logging | `false` |\n| `CLASP_DEBUG_REQUESTS` | Log requests only | `false` |\n| `CLASP_DEBUG_RESPONSES` | Log responses only | `false` |\n| `CLASP_RATE_LIMIT` | Enable rate limiting | `false` |\n| automatically map Claude model tiers to your provider's models:\n\n```bash\n# Map Claude tiers to specific models\nexport CLASP_MODEL_OPUS=gpt-4o\nexport CLASP_MODEL_SONNET=gpt-4o-mini\nexport CLASP_MODEL_HAIKU=gpt-3.5-turbo\n```\n\n### Multi-Provider Routing\n\nRoute different Claude model tiers to different LLM providers for cost optimization:\n\n```bash\n# Enable multi-provider routing\nexport CLASP_MULTI_PROVIDER=true\n\n# Route Opus tier to OpenAI (premium)\nexport CLASP_OPUS_PROVIDER=openai\nexport CLASP_OPUS_MODEL=gpt-4o\nexport CLASP_OPUS_API_KEY=sk-...  # Optional, inherits from OPENAI_API_KEY\n\n# Route Sonnet tier to OpenRouter (cost-effective)\nexport CLASP_SONNET_PROVIDER=openrouter\nexport CLASP_SONNET_MODEL=anthropic/claude-3-sonnet\nexport CLASP_SONNET_API_KEY=sk-or-...  # Optional, inherits from OPENROUTER_API_KEY\n\n# Route Haiku tier to local Ollama (free)\nexport CLASP_HAIKU_PROVIDER=custom\nexport CLASP_HAIKU_MODEL=llama3.1\nexport CLASP_HAIKU_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1\n\nclasp -multi-provider\n```\n\n**Multi-Provider Environment Variables:**\n\n| Variable | Description |\n|----------|-------------|\n| `CLASP_MULTI_PROVIDER` | Enable multi-provider routing (`true`/`1`) |\n| `CLASP_{TIER}_PROVIDER` | Provider for tier: `openai`, `openrouter`, `custom` |\n| `CLASP_{TIER}_MODEL` | Model name for the tier |\n| `CLASP_{TIER}_API_KEY` | API key (optional, inherits from main config) |\n| `CLASP_{TIER}_BASE_URL` | Base URL (optional, uses provider default) |\n\nWhere `{TIER}` is `OPUS`, `SONNET`, or `HAIKU`.\n\n**Benefits:**\n- **Cost Optimization**: Use expensive providers only for complex tasks\n- **Latency Reduction**: Route simple requests to faster local models\n- **Redundancy**: Mix cloud and local providers for reliability\n- **A/B Testing**: Compare different models across tiers\n\n## API Endpoints\n\n| Endpoint | Description |\n|----------|-------------|\n| `POST /v1/messages` | \"model\": \"claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\",\n    \"max_tokens\": 1024,\n    \"messages\": [\n      {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Hello!\"}\n    ]\n  }'\n```\n\n### Streaming\n\n```bash\ncurl http://localhost:8080/v1/messages \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -H \"x-api-key: any-key\" \\\n  -d '{\n    \"model\": \"claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\",\n    \"max_tokens\": 1024,\n    \"stream\": true,\n    \"messages\": [\n      {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Count to 5\"}\n    ]\n  }'\n```\n\n## Response Caching\n\nCLASP can cache responses to reduce API costs and improve latency for repeated requests:\n\n```bash\n# Enable caching with defaults (1000 entries, 1 hour TTL)\nclasp -cache\n\n# Custom cache settings\nclasp -cache -cache-max-size 500 -cache-ttl 1800\n\n# Via environment\nCLASP_CACHE=true CLASP_CACHE_MAX_SIZE=500 clasp\n```\n\n**Caching behavior:**\n- Only non-streaming requests are cached\n- Requests with `temperature > 0` are not cached (non-deterministic)\n- Cache uses LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction when full\n- Cache entries expire after TTL (time-to-live)\n- Response headers include `X-CLASP-Cache: HIT` or `X-CLASP-Cache: MISS`\n\n## Metrics\n\nAccess `/metrics` for request statistics:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"requests\": {\n    \"total\": 100,\n    \"successful\": 98,\n    \"errors\": 2,\n    \"streaming\": 75,\n circuit breaker | `false` |\n| `CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD` | Failures before opening circuit | `5` |\n| `CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RECOVERY` | Successes to close circuit | `2` |\n| `CLASP_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TIMEOUT` | Timeout in seconds before retry | `30` |\n\n### Circuit Breaker States\n\n- **Closed**: Normal operation, requests pass through\n- **Open**: Circuit tripped, requests fail fast with 503\n- **Half-Open**: Testing if service recovered, limited requests allowed\n\n### Maximum Resilience Configuration\n\nFor production deployments requiring maximum
